corrections: Individual rounded 412EP nose and chin windows, broad dual cockpit glazing, separate pilot/hinged/sliding doors, twin-engine cowling and exhausts, low skid geometry and conventional fin.
Four-blade rotor head, tapered tail boom, stabilizers, seam lines, rivets, wipers, steps and navigation lights.

Analog EP panel individually placed from N7506M photograph, asymmetric navigation fit, twin engine gauge columns, warning grid and fire handles; overhead and pedestal controls, dual cyclics/collectives/pedals and fifteen seats.
limitations: Dimension sheet is schematic and its front hub height differs from side; printed dimensions take precedence. Static rotor azimuth and blade droop differ from the drawing.
Panel homography uses inferred corners and gauge roundness. Absolute panel width, coaming depth and cabin placement remain reconstruction assumptions.

The cockpit is a 2006 analog EP equipment fit. The fifteen-seat layout follows the manufacturer standard interior, while overhead structure is corroborated by a related AB-412 photo; equipment installations vary.
Instrument legends, controls and engine indications are simplified for the assisted flight simulation. No reference pixels or manufacturer artwork are shipped.

controlReview.checks: Imported GLB control-point movement tested at positive and negative commands; all 20 aircraft pass. Cockpit pairs and all ten airplane exterior pairs visually inspected. Roll, pitch, rudder and declared pedal directions corrected; ailerons and full flap deployment corrected.
limitations: Checks cover existing bindings; Cherokee and Caravan pedal geometry is static.
Full control travel and flight response remain approximations unless independently dimensioned in the model reference notes.
This audit verifies movement; it does not upgrade legacy helicopter avionics or remove previously documented geometry limitations.
